question: Contá los ensayos con pembrolizumab cuyo estado es activo (reclutando, activo sin reclutar, todavía sin reclutar o por invitación).

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE s.overall_status IN ('RECRUITING', 'ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING', 'NOT_YET_RECRUITING', 'ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND i.name ILIKE '%pembrolizumab%')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND o.name ILIKE '%pembrolizumab%'))
